decisions.reason: Management has invested and publicly committed to this product over two years, and disappointing results can still be seen as temporary, so escalation of commitment implies keeping it.
As a recently launched product with a visible website page and sunk development costs, management is inclined to persist and give it more time before considering withdrawal.
The product is close to the core communication offer and has just been publicly launched, so escalation of commitment leads to keeping it to justify the investment.
